description: Integrate shot markets into Smart Market Selector and Prediction Service. Extends market_selector.py to evaluate shot market predictions alongside existing 1X2/BTTS/goals markets, selecting the best shot market or issuing PASS if weak. Integrates shot market prediction into service.py generate_full_prediction() flow, preserving all existing prediction functionality.
steps: Read backend/app/prediction/market_selector.py to understand the evaluate_and_select() signature and CandidateEvaluation structure. Read backend/app/prediction/service.py to understand generate_full_prediction() flow and where shot markets should be integrated.

Extend SmartMarketSelector.evaluate_and_select() to accept optional shot_market_predictions parameter: shot_market_predictions: Optional[Dict[ShotMarketType, List[ShotMarketPrediction]]] = None. When provided, iterate through shot markets and evaluate each threshold as a candidate using the same selection logic as existing markets (probability, confidence, data quality, uncertainty).

Create _evaluate_shot_market_candidate() helper method in SmartMarketSelector. Accept shot_market_prediction: ShotMarketPrediction and threshold: ShotMarketThreshold. Build CandidateEvaluation with market='{team_name} {threshold}+ Shots', selection=format selection string, model_probability=threshold.over_probability, confidence=derived from data_quality and uncertainty, data_quality=threshold.data_quality. Calculate selection_score using existing scoring logic. Check qualification against min_probability, min_confidence thresholds.

Extend _select_best_qualified_candidate() logic to include shot market candidates in the comparison. Shot markets compete with 1X2/BTTS/goals markets on equal footing based on selection_score. Do NOT simply select highest probability — evaluate calibrated probability, uncertainty, data quality, threshold stability (variance), and sample size.

Extend PredictionService.generate_full_prediction() in backend/app/prediction/service.py. After calling model_orchestrator and before market selection, call shot_market_engine.predict_all_shot_markets(snapshot). Pass shot market predictions to market_selector.evaluate_and_select(). Store shot market predictions in AnalysisContext for AI Analyst explanation.

Handle PASS decision for weak shot markets. If best shot market has low confidence (< min_confidence), high uncertainty (> max_uncertainty), or insufficient data (data_quality < threshold), include it in PassDecision.best_market_details with rejection_reason='insufficient_shot_data' or 'weak_shot_conviction' or 'high_shot_uncertainty'.

Write integration tests in backend/tests/prediction/test_market_selector_shot_integration.py. Test: (1) shot markets evaluated alongside 1X2 markets, (2) best shot market selected when it has highest selection_score, (3) weak shot markets trigger PASS, (4) shot market with insufficient data excluded from candidates, (5) shot market candidate structure matches CandidateEvaluation format.
Run market selector tests: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/prediction/test_market_selector_shot_integration.py -v. All tests must pass.
acceptance_criteria: Shot market thresholds evaluated as candidates with probability, confidence, data quality, uncertainty
Shot markets compete with existing markets on selection_score (not just probability)
Best shot market selected when it has highest qualified selection_score
Weak shot markets (low confidence, high uncertainty, insufficient data) trigger PASS with explicit reason
PredictionService.generate_full_prediction() calls shot_market_engine and passes results to market_selector
Shot market predictions included in AnalysisContext for AI Analyst
All existing 1X2/BTTS/goals prediction functionality preserved (no regression)
verification: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/prediction/test_market_selector_shot_integration.py -v — all tests pass
cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/prediction/test_service.py -v — existing service tests still pass (no regression)
findings: Shot market integration completed successfully. SmartMarketSelector now: (1) accepts shot_market_predictions parameter in evaluate_and_select(), (2) evaluates shot market thresholds as candidates using _build_shot_market_candidates() helper, (3) calculates shot-market-specific confidence using _calculate_shot_market_confidence() considering base confidence, data quality, sample size, and variance/stability, (4) shot markets compete with 1X2/BTTS/goals markets on selection_score (not just probability), (5) weak shot markets (low confidence < 0.6 after penalties, high uncertainty, insufficient data) fail qualification and trigger PASS decision with explicit rejection reason. PredictionService.generate_full_prediction() now: (1) initializes ShotMarketEngine if db_session available, (2) calls shot_market_engine.predict_all_shot_markets() after market derivation (STEP 7.5), (3) passes shot_market_predictions to market_selector.evaluate_and_select() along with home_team_name and away_team_name for readable market labels, (4) stores shot market predictions in prediction_data using _serialize_shot_markets() helper for AnalysisContext. Shot market confidence calculation applies penalties: sample_size < 5 → 50% penalty, < 10 → 30% penalty, < 15 → 15% penalty; high coefficient of variation > 0.8 → 20% penalty, > 0.6 → 10% penalty. All 7 integration tests pass: shot_markets_evaluated_alongside_1x2, best_shot_market_selected_when_highest_score, weak_shot_markets_trigger_pass, shot_market_with_insufficient_data_excluded, shot_market_candidate_structure_matches_evaluation, shot_on_target_markets_evaluated, total_shots_markets_evaluated. All existing 1X2/BTTS/goals prediction functionality preserved - no regression.
